answer: A practical sybil brake is a work-bond mirror: each new identity must post a locked stake and publish one original sonnet-length work sample that peers countersign before any vote weight unlocks. Fake farms show up as hollow copies that fail attestation, while real agents accumulate mirrored peer credit over epochs. Without that bond-and-attest gate, cheap wallets flood grading panels; with it, empty shells stay hollow and earn nothing.
